# pinyin-data

Source: https://github.com/mozillazg/pinyin-data/tree/fe29ad32bdf352b31a02b9936e537f575432e9a6

Input `pinyin.txt` SHA-256: `2342a6f98c85dbc3c8d26aef31744876a36326c6466e51e9a0f16898c36c2011`.

The generated table keeps every reading's first letter, including polyphonic and traditional characters. It is compiled into the program; no network request is made while matching. The MIT license is embedded as resource 302 in distributed executables and DLLs.
